Prayer of wind Necklace.Name: Prayer of wind Necklace
Prayer of wind Necklace.Description: A white feather and turquoise beads on a long cord, rubbed smooth by palms before every high ridge.

Stamina Regen Elixir.Name: Stamina Regen Elixir
Stamina Regen Elixir.Description: Sharp alchemist's cordial that keeps tired limbs recovering longer after the swallow.

Mist Kumo Sodenashi.Description: Sleeveless mist cloud cloth, built light for roads where shapes vanish before names do.
Mist Kumo Sodenashi.Name: Mist Kumo Sodenashi

Eye Patch.Description: Oil dark leather cut for use rather than pity, worn long after the wound beneath it learned to predict weather.
Eye Patch.Name: Eye Patch

Overdrive Earrings.Name: Overdrive Earrings
Overdrive Earrings.Description: Silver crescents pinned with a four point star, made for hands that never quite leave a fight idle.

Nightfall Claws.Name: Nightfall Claws
Nightfall Claws.Description: Deep green set claws banded in gold over old bandages, for the moment a demon turns a hit taken into a hit returned.

Arrow Orb.Description: Veined glass for an unbound demon core. Squeeze it to start Arrow core training, where force learns hidden direction.
Arrow Orb.Name: Arrow Orb

Fox Mask.Description: The white and red kitsune face from every festival stall, with strap marks from someone who walked a long way past the stalls.
Fox Mask.Name: Fox Mask

Ice Demon Hat.Description: The same broad hat in pale blue, tilted low and grown over with cyan shards, with snow marks settled along the brim.
Ice Demon Hat.Name: Ice Demon Hat

Shackle Eyepatch.Description: A dark eyepatch with a chain looped from its strap. It was made to starve the wearer of strength, so that every fight would last a little longer.
Shackle Eyepatch.Name: Shackle Eyepatch

Damascus War Fans.Name: Damascus War Fans
Damascus War Fans.Description: Violet ribs cut cold air. Cryokinesis answers through them, and a chant can change the gale.

Paper Bag.Description: A sack with a hole torn for the eyes. Costs almost nothing, hides very nearly everything.
Paper Bag.Name: Paper Bag

Serpent Necklace.Name: Serpent Necklace
Serpent Necklace.Description: A silver snake coiling down the cord, polished bright where it rubs the collarbone.

Flame Slayer Uniform.Name: Flame Slayer Uniform
Flame Slayer Uniform.Description: Rengu's Corps uniform carries singed cuffs and a collar set high against sparks from Flame Breathing.

Cross Visor Mask.Description: A pale pointed mask with a cross cut through the face, like a knight's visor. The ones who wear it say they pulled it from somewhere inside themselves.
Cross Visor Mask.Name: Cross Visor Mask

Todoroki Koshimaki.Name: Todoroki Koshimaki
Todoroki Koshimaki.Description: Split red and white waist cloth, singed at the edge and frost pale through the inner wrap.

Tornadic Katana.Name: Tornadic Katana
Tornadic Katana.Description: A deep green curve, polished so fine at the edge that loose dust lifts when it leaves the sheath.

Stone Necklace.Name: Stone Necklace
Stone Necklace.Description: Stone prayer beads modeled after Gyorei's own burden, heavy enough to make silence feel earned.

Serpentine Katana.Name: Serpentine Katana
Serpentine Katana.Description: Violet and green light coils the length of the spine, a blade made to change line without warning and punish a missed guard.

Butterfly Katana.Name: Butterfly Katana
Butterfly Katana.Description: A narrow black Nichirin that trails violet light off the edge, made for thrusts that land before the poison has to finish anything.

Runic Eye Mask.Description: Dark cloth ringed with ink marks copied off warding charms whose meanings nobody living can quite finish explaining.
Runic Eye Mask.Name: Runic Eye Mask

Firstlight Tanto Schematic.Description: Plans for a short blade, the grip drawn twice over where the first attempt sat wrong in the hand.
Firstlight Tanto Schematic.Name: Firstlight Tanto Schematic

Butterfly Hair Clip.Name: Butterfly Hair Clip
Butterfly Hair Clip.Description: Shinora's violet wing clip, light enough that a fast fighter forgets it is pinned there at all.

Firstlight Mask.Name: Firstlight Mask
Firstlight Mask.Description: A high crowned faceplate in set white and gold. Sighted through, wooden walls give up every seam and knot a carpenter hoped would hold.

Mythic Refinement Ore.Description: Dense refinement ore for the forge's hardest work, smelted from lesser stone or pried from hard-won caches.
Mythic Refinement Ore.Name: Mythic Refinement Ore

Nightfall Katana.Name: Nightfall Katana
Nightfall Katana.Description: Set steel that drinks lamplight instead of returning any. Plating goes into its edge the way a whetstone goes into lesser blades.

Indigo Frost Coat.Description: Indigo dyed coat for Iceveil winters, lined thick at the ribs and dark at the cuffs from stove smoke.
Indigo Frost Coat.Name: Indigo Frost Coat

Damascus Sickles.Name: Damascus Sickles
Damascus Sickles.Description: Damascus grain runs through the twin sickles, letting a demon carve Blood Manipulation into hooked arcs.

Crown of Ages.Description: A heavy gold crown ringed with spikes, made for the king of an empty desert. Everything that ever knelt before it has long since turned to dust.
Crown of Ages.Name: Crown of Ages

Damascus Bladed Wagasa.Name: Damascus Bladed Wagasa
Damascus Bladed Wagasa.Description: A violet canopy on hardened ribs, keeping sunlight off overhead while steel petals answer underneath.

Straw Fringe Hat.Name: Straw Fringe Hat
Straw Fringe Hat.Description: A wide straw hat with dark cords hanging past the jaw, hiding a face from recognition and a demon from the sun. Iceveil marauders favor it.

Sound Slayer Uniform.Name: Sound Slayer Uniform
Sound Slayer Uniform.Description: Tengai's festival bright uniform is patched for thunderous movement, with seams that look built for noise.

Spiral Mask.Name: Spiral Mask
Spiral Mask.Description: One orange spiral, one eyehole, and a wearer who insists he is nobody worth naming. Nobody believes that twice.

Nightfall Scythe Schematic.Description: Plans for a scythe, the blade drawn in one sweep by a hand that did not lift the pen.
Nightfall Scythe Schematic.Name: Nightfall Scythe Schematic

Torned Ninja Scarf.Description: Dark red shinobi cloth frayed to ribbons by fast climbs and rather faster exits through the tower's upper dark.
Torned Ninja Scarf.Name: Torned Ninja Scarf

Enru's Bottom.Name: Enru's Bottom
Enru's Bottom.Description: Enru's trousers are soft enough for sleep and cut loose enough to run when the dream breaks.

Firstlight Star Ore.Description: Star flecked ore reserved for Firstlight work. Ordinary scrap cannot smelt into this grain.
Firstlight Star Ore.Name: Firstlight Star Ore

Combat.Name: Combat
Combat.Description: Bare fists, kept as the starting stance. Most demons cast their Blood Art through it when no weapon is drawn.

Black Vulture Hat.Name: Black Vulture Hat
Black Vulture Hat.Description: A black brimmed hat with a spray of pale feathers at one side, cut for fighters who stay close and wait for the other to tire.

Firstlight Haori.Name: Firstlight Haori
Firstlight Haori.Description: Dawn pale Firstlight silk, woven to order for Corps defenders who intend to still be standing at sunrise.

Nightfall Axe and Mace Schematic.Description: Plans for a matched pair, the axe on one page and the mace on the other, joined by a single chain drawn across the fold.
Nightfall Axe and Mace Schematic.Name: Nightfall Axe and Mace Schematic

Bladed Wagasa.Name: Bladed Wagasa
Bladed Wagasa.Description: Fujiko's parasol opens navy and gold overhead, holding the sun off a demon while its ribs come down like falling petals.

OuwFwesh.Description: Dockhands keep the old misspelling on the tag. The fish itself is clean, pale, and good for crates.
OuwFwesh.Name: OuwFwesh

Court Captain's Haori.Description: White and full sleeved, with a crest set in a diamond at the back. Only thirteen were ever cut to this pattern, one for each company's captain.
Court Captain's Haori.Name: Court Captain's Haori

Tidal Katana.Name: Tidal Katana
Tidal Katana.Description: Dark blue steel that carries white foam up its length, steady as a harbor tide and difficult to turn aside.

Flame Veil.Description: Black cloth marked with gold strokes and hung with tassels, drawn up when a night fight turns toward flame.
Flame Veil.Name: Flame Veil

Blood Sickles.Name: Blood Sickles
Blood Sickles.Description: Gyutai's paired sickles draw Blood Manipulation through their own blades, sending the art where bare hands cannot.

Classic Straw Hat.Name: Classic Straw Hat
Classic Straw Hat.Description: Honest farmer's straw, woven wide and tight enough to turn back daylight. The plainest thing a demon can wear outdoors.

Bear Claws.Description: Curved bear claws, cleaned but still nicked with bark from Bamboo Grove den trees.
Bear Claws.Name: Bear Claws

Supply Box.Description: Mistfall's supply crate for Shiori's Estate stores, carried in hand until the delivery is signed off.
Supply Box.Name: Supply Box

Bokashi-Zome Kata-Aki.Name: Bokashi-Zome Kata-Aki
Bokashi-Zome Kata-Aki.Description: Gradient dyed shoulder cloth from the tower's harder floors, made for hands that never waste motion.

Firstlight Bottom.Name: Firstlight Bottom
Firstlight Bottom.Description: A pleated white wrap edged in gold, part of the Firstlight set and made to hold a stance rather than to hurry anywhere.

Obi Manipulation Orb.Description: Something dark and silken coils inside. Squeezing it starts Obi Manipulation core training for an unclaimed demon core.
Obi Manipulation Orb.Name: Obi Manipulation Orb

Coin Pouch.Description: Tied pouch of Wen, heavy enough to make a belt sag on the road to market.
Coin Pouch.Name: Coin Pouch

Sound Trainer.Description: Tengai's teaching clothes are loud only in the way they sit, every fold waiting for a beat to land.
Sound Trainer.Name: Sound Trainer

Clown Fish.Description: Brightly banded harbor catch, pretty enough for market talk and useful when pantries need more than small fry.
Clown Fish.Name: Clown Fish

Health Regen Potion.Name: Health Regen Potion
Health Regen Potion.Description: Bitter medicine that hastens natural healing for a short while once swallowed.

Faceless Helm.Description: A tall helm in dull sand that hides the whole head. Its first owner hid behind it for years, sure no one would follow a captain with a wolf's face.
Faceless Helm.Name: Faceless Helm

Insect Necklace.Name: Insect Necklace
Insect Necklace.Description: A pale butterfly at the throat, the mark Insect students wear before they have earned anything heavier.

Akazo's Bottom.Name: Akazo's Bottom
Akazo's Bottom.Description: Akazo's wide pale trousers, hung with red tassels at the waist and left loose so bare feet can drive through broken ground.

Nightfall Cape.Name: Nightfall Cape
Nightfall Cape.Description: Deep green under the set's gold edging, hanging close at the shoulder until the road goes properly dark.

Autumn Haori.Name: Autumn Haori
Autumn Haori.Description: Cloth dyed in turning maple, cut for long marches, its hem darkened by wet roads and harbor smoke.

Damask Kata-Aki.Description: Deep red damask piped in pale pink, formal work that never quite settles into being road clothes.
Damask Kata-Aki.Name: Damask Kata-Aki

Firstlight Top.Name: Firstlight Top
Firstlight Top.Description: Cream cloth crossed at the chest under a gilded sun pauldron. No shop stocks the Firstlight set, it is forged and then forged further.

Demon Horns.Description: Charred horn tips cut from demons, traded by trainers and alchemists who know what can be ground from them.
Demon Horns.Name: Demon Horns

Azure Necklace.Name: Azure Necklace
Azure Necklace.Description: Blue stones set into a silver collar piece, polished smooth by long climbs and longer waits at locked doors.

Kuzushiji Kata-Aki.Name: Kuzushiji Kata-Aki
Kuzushiji Kata-Aki.Description: Cursive script runs over the shoulder cloth, part prayer and part field note in a scholar's hurried hand.

Dev Cape.Name: Dev Cape
Dev Cape.Description: A black maker's mantle broken by white waves and a name in gold, stitched for the hands that shaped the world itself.

Matsuba Haori.Description: Matsuba patterned haori from Iceveil racks, pine needle green against snow and smoke.
Matsuba Haori.Name: Matsuba Haori

Crustadon.Description: Heavy shelled deepwater brute. Old anglers keep it whole, remembering what dragged a man below.
Crustadon.Name: Crustadon

Frostfang Kitsune Mask.Description: A pale kitsune with frost blue fangs, said to watch the cold paths where careless breath turns white.
Frostfang Kitsune Mask.Name: Frostfang Kitsune Mask

Akatsuki Straw Hat.Name: Akatsuki Straw Hat
Akatsuki Straw Hat.Description: A straw hat hung all round with pale paper streamers and one red tassel, woven close enough to keep the sun off a demon.

Beast Core.Description: Hard kernel cut from a beast born demon, prized by teachers who ask for proof before sharing harder forms.
Beast Core.Name: Beast Core

Crown of the Brave.Description: A gilded laurel handed to whoever wins the grove's yearly bout. It proves nothing, which is rather the point.
Crown of the Brave.Name: Crown of the Brave

Karakusa Kata-Aki.Description: Shoulder cut karakusa cloth, lighter than the cloak and meant to be folded into a travel pack.
Karakusa Kata-Aki.Name: Karakusa Kata-Aki

Firstlight Bladed Wagasa Schematic.Description: Folding plans for a bladed parasol, drawn in a set hand that expected the reader to already know the hard parts.
Firstlight Bladed Wagasa Schematic.Name: Firstlight Bladed Wagasa Schematic

Black Kumo Haori.Description: Black travel cloth with gold cords looped at both shoulders, a quiet mark that reads as a warning to anyone who knows it.
Black Kumo Haori.Name: Black Kumo Haori

Midnight Blossom Cloak.Name: Midnight Blossom Cloak
Midnight Blossom Cloak.Description: Black cloth scattered with night blossoms, the lining cold from Iceveil storehouses and moonlit docks.

Shockwave Necklace.Name: Shockwave Necklace
Shockwave Necklace.Description: A silver burst frozen part way open, its arms bent as though sound itself had struck it.

Sargent’s Kesa.Description: A clean lavender kesa trimmed in blue and tied with gold cord, closer to parade order than to anything worn on a road.
Sargent’s Kesa.Name: Sargent’s Kesa

Arrow Necklace.Name: Arrow Necklace
Arrow Necklace.Description: A red arrowhead hung point down, cut to the same pattern the arrow demon leaves in anyone who runs.

Yahari Necklace.Name: Yahari Necklace
Yahari Necklace.Description: Yahari's arrow eye pendant, taken from night roads where unseen arrows bent every escape.

Biwa Bell.Description: Ringing it opens the covered road to Muzan's lair. The tone belongs to demons even when lent to humans.
Biwa Bell.Name: Biwa Bell

Coin Stack.Description: Worn coins bound in twine, useful only after a trader weighs them out.
Coin Stack.Name: Coin Stack

Firstlight Lantern Schematic.Description: Plans for a caged lamp, the wick drawn nine ways over before one of them held.
Firstlight Lantern Schematic.Name: Firstlight Lantern Schematic

Moonlit Kata-Aki.Name: Moonlit Kata-Aki
Moonlit Kata-Aki.Description: Deep blue shoulder cloth scattered with pale moons, its weave keeping the hush of frozen shrines.

Flame Katana.Name: Flame Katana
Flame Katana.Description: Rengu's Nichirin runs red along its length and takes open fire the moment it clears the sheath.

Coin.Description: Loose coin with a dull stamped face, tarnished by many hands and ready for the money counter.
Coin.Name: Coin

Ichimatsu Erimaki.Description: A checkered winter scarf woven for Iceveil streets, thick enough to keep its pattern under falling snow.
Ichimatsu Erimaki.Name: Ichimatsu Erimaki

Frozen Heart Cache.Description: Sealed cache containing a Frozen Heart, kept for waking the Yeti's berg when coin is not enough.
Frozen Heart Cache.Name: Frozen Heart Cache

Crescent Marked Veil.Name: Crescent Marked Veil
Crescent Marked Veil.Description: A pale face veil marked with a single red sun, drawn on by fighters who prefer to be noticed late.

Scythe.Name: Scythe
Scythe.Description: A demon's reaping blade from sealed caches, built around wide slashes and a blood hungry follow-up.

Demonic Horns II.Name: Demonic Horns II
Demonic Horns II.Description: A heavier gray pair that curls back like a ram's, thick enough at the base to take a hit without snapping.

Tamari Necklace.Name: Tamari Necklace
Tamari Necklace.Description: A painted temari ball on a cord, its lacquer chipped where Sumari's art pulled the thread tight.

Purple Kumo Kesa.Description: Purple cloud patterns gather over this kesa, soft at the collar from years of careful folding.
Purple Kumo Kesa.Name: Purple Kumo Kesa

Scarred Warding Mask.Name: Scarred Warding Mask
Scarred Warding Mask.Description: Sabito's warding mask, gouged along the cheek. He wore it to the end and never once took it off for anybody.

Sound Katanas.Name: Sound Katanas
Sound Katanas.Description: Tengai's paired Nichirin blades are chained for rhythm, each swing landing like a drumbeat through smoke.

Black Cape.Description: Plain black cloth with a traveler's fade at the hem, useful when bright colors would say too much.
Black Cape.Name: Black Cape

Blindfolds.Description: Teal training cloth for learning footsteps, breath, and the shift of a sleeve before the blade ever clears.
Blindfolds.Name: Blindfolds

Thunder Haori.Name: Thunder Haori
Thunder Haori.Description: Zentaro's orange haori, its hem broken into white scales. That pattern is the last thing most people see before he is already past them.

Sea Horse.Description: Small curled catch from eelgrass beds, dried whole for market stalls and anglers' crates.
Sea Horse.Name: Sea Horse

Cryokinesis Necklace.Name: Cryokinesis Necklace
Cryokinesis Necklace.Description: A pale snowflake that never melts off its cord, threaded for those who learned to make winter answer.

Nightfall Scythe.Name: Nightfall Scythe
Nightfall Scythe.Description: A green and gold set blade for demon hands, its long edge made to sweep wide and answer with bloodlust.

Book of Guidance.Description: Kona's recovered pages, bound into a road worn book with margins marked by travelers who needed direction.
Book of Guidance.Name: Book of Guidance

Nightfall Reinforced Plating.Description: Layered Nightfall plating for set work, a gate material no ordinary scrap can stand in for.
Nightfall Reinforced Plating.Name: Nightfall Reinforced Plating

Flame Haori Style 2.Name: Flame Haori Style 2
Flame Haori Style 2.Description: Rengu's haori, white above and broad flame below, scorched along the lining and never once burned through.

Azure Cloak.Description: Blue cloth with a salt stiff edge, the sort kept near docks when the fog comes in hard.
Azure Cloak.Name: Azure Cloak

Yukiume Fur Coat.Description: Snow plum fur coat, soft at the collar and heavy enough to make Iceveil wind feel briefly human.
Yukiume Fur Coat.Name: Yukiume Fur Coat

War Fans.Name: War Fans
War Fans.Description: Domae's fans open gold and lotus painted, though what answers through them is Cryokinesis and a chant that hardens the gale.

Health Potion.Description: Field bottle for quick mending. Drink it to close a fresh wound before the next exchange.
Health Potion.Name: Health Potion

Monster Paper Bag.Description: The same sack, torn into a snarl and fitted with small red horns. Somehow this one costs more.
Monster Paper Bag.Name: Monster Paper Bag

Flame Scarf.Name: Flame Scarf
Flame Scarf.Description: Dark cloth that burns out into orange at the fringe, kept by fighters who have stood too near a battlefield blaze.

Firstlight Sound Cleavers Schematic.Description: Plans for a matched pair of cleavers, the edges drawn with the same stroke so they ring at one pitch.
Firstlight Sound Cleavers Schematic.Name: Firstlight Sound Cleavers Schematic

Battle-Torn Haori.Description: A captain's white haori with the sleeves gone and the hem torn to rags. Its owner never mended it, since mending would mean the fight was over.
Battle-Torn Haori.Name: Battle-Torn Haori

Deku Haori.Description: Teal cloth printed with curling scrollwork and cut with a deep hood, mended so often the seams became part of the pattern.
Deku Haori.Name: Deku Haori

Black Kumo Slayers Uniform.Name: Black Kumo Slayers Uniform
Black Kumo Slayers Uniform.Description: A dark navy uniform under gold braid, cut with a guarded sleeve for Slayers who expect to meet claws at close range.

Masquerade Mask.Description: Polished for court halls and then scratched by travel, a borrowed face for nights when names stay folded away.
Masquerade Mask.Name: Masquerade Mask

Water Haori.Name: Water Haori
Water Haori.Description: Giyen's haori, plain dark on one side and a field of green and gold blocks on the other, calm at the collar and severe at the hem.

Shima Koshimaki.Description: Striped waist cloth wrapped over travel wear, simple work from the same hands that mend dock rope.
Shima Koshimaki.Name: Shima Koshimaki

Azure Guard Armour.Name: Azure Guard Armour
Azure Guard Armour.Description: Polished blue plate from back room trade, made for guards who expect the opening hit to land.

Floral Warding Mask.Name: Floral Warding Mask
Floral Warding Mask.Description: A warding fox painted over with blue flowers, the old scars underneath still readable if you tilt it to the light.

Nightfall Top.Name: Nightfall Top
Nightfall Top.Description: Nightfall cloth crossed at the chest in quiet layers. Not looted and not bought, only built and then built further.

Golden Fish.Description: A fish bright as sun on water, used as payment for a finer rod, more valuable on the counter than in a supper crate.
Golden Fish.Name: Golden Fish

Insect Haori.Name: Insect Haori
Insect Haori.Description: Shinora's haori, its sleeves fading from gray into butterfly wing, sharp with the memory of poisoned thrusts.

Sightless Visor.Description: A smooth gray band worn across the eyes, useless to anyone who needs to see. Its owner never did, and listened for crickets instead.
Sightless Visor.Name: Sightless Visor

Wayfarer Mask.Description: A cracked white traveler's mask, salt marked along the edges by the long roads down into Mistfall Harbor.
Wayfarer Mask.Name: Wayfarer Mask

Stylish Haori.Name: Stylish Haori
Stylish Haori.Description: Pink and trimmed in feathers, cut open to show the shirt. It matches the boa, the lenses and the grin, because of course it does.

Wondering Obi Belt.Name: Wondering Obi Belt
Wondering Obi Belt.Description: A navy waist wrap bound with a thick braided purple cord, its long tail left hanging like a question nobody answered.

Nightfall Cape Schematic.Description: A cape pattern drawn from a torn one, every tear marked where the cloth should have held.
Nightfall Cape Schematic.Name: Nightfall Cape Schematic

Tidal Necklace.Name: Tidal Necklace
Tidal Necklace.Description: A pale shell strung on knotted twine, passed quietly through markets that open and vanish in a day.

Severed Chain Cape.Description: A high collared cape with a round clasp and a short chain that was cut, not broken. Worn by a stand-in guardian who never gave the job back.
Severed Chain Cape.Name: Severed Chain Cape

Mimic Necklace.Name: Mimic Necklace
Mimic Necklace.Description: Gilt studs on a dark cord, worth rather less than the first glance across a market stall suggests.

Two-Horned Mask.Name: Two-Horned Mask
Two-Horned Mask.Description: Twin silver horns over frost pale lacquer, trailing blue tassels, for fighters who answer danger by closing the gap.

Lost Mask.Name: Lost Mask
Lost Mask.Description: Great gold horns curling off a lacquered brow, silt still packed in the seams from wherever the Lost one went down.

Fire Demon Hat.Description: A broad hat worn at a hard tilt, deep red and bristling with shards along the crown. The Profound Demons of fire wear them.
Fire Demon Hat.Name: Fire Demon Hat

Coin Pile.Description: Chest coins swept together, more salvage than keepsake until a merchant counts them.
Coin Pile.Name: Coin Pile

Azure Earrings.Name: Azure Earrings
Azure Earrings.Description: Blue stones seated in pale silver mounts, bright enough to catch what little moonlight gets under a hood.

Peppermint Scarf.Name: Peppermint Scarf
Peppermint Scarf.Description: Red and white wool with the bite of winter mint, too clean for the road until the first hard march.

Firstlight Spear Schematic.Description: Plans for a spear, the shaft measured in hand-widths and the head drawn far larger than it needs to be.
Firstlight Spear Schematic.Name: Firstlight Spear Schematic

Shockwave Orb.Description: Heavy in the palm, this orb starts Shockwave core training when crushed hard enough for the body to answer.
Shockwave Orb.Name: Shockwave Orb

Ice Necklace.Name: Ice Necklace
Ice Necklace.Description: A blue gem cut hard and sunk in dark metal, the sort of thing found at the bottom of a locked cache.

Damascus Gauntlet.Name: Damascus Gauntlet
Damascus Gauntlet.Description: Violet plates wrap the fists, turning flash step work into shattering footing and heavy throws.

One-Horned Imp Mask.Description: A blue imp with one horn snapped short and a crooked grin, made to frighten children before real demons taught the village better.
One-Horned Imp Mask.Name: One-Horned Imp Mask

Hiyozu's Scarf.Name: Hiyozu's Scarf
Hiyozu's Scarf.Description: Hoyuzo's scarf, travel stained and carefully mended. Enough road marauders wear copies now that it reads as a warning.

Monocle.Description: A single cold polished lens for reading faded maps when snow glare makes every mark on them look the same.
Monocle.Name: Monocle

Kikkō Sodenashi.Name: Kikkō Sodenashi
Kikkō Sodenashi.Description: Kikko style hex panels cover this sleeveless coat, a guard's pattern softened by long use.

Blossom Spirit Mask.Name: Blossom Spirit Mask
Blossom Spirit Mask.Description: A pink fox face dusted with flowers, its petal paint worn thin at the cheeks from being worn far past the festival.

Damascus Spear.Name: Damascus Spear
Damascus Spear.Description: Violet climbs the spearhead, steadying a storm rush charge and the pierce that catches a foe clean.

Heavenly Boa.Name: Heavenly Boa
Heavenly Boa.Description: A pale rose boa, absurdly soft and far too clean for any of the roads it is supposed to have crossed.

Domae's Top.Name: Domae's Top
Domae's Top.Description: Pale upper robe from Domae's wardrobe, too fine for the cold it carried into every welcome.

Shovel.Description: A short handled shovel with a chipped iron blade. The snow mounds around Iceveil hide more than snow.
Shovel.Name: Shovel

Plume Haori.Name: Plume Haori
Plume Haori.Description: Plume marks sweep across the back, cut for runners who want the cloth to vanish behind them.

Black Bandana.Description: Plain cloth tied back off the brow, the first thing most fighters buy and the last thing they bother replacing.
Black Bandana.Name: Black Bandana

Watcher's Patch.Description: A watchman's lensed patch with the strap rubbed smooth, kept for long vigils where a narrow view is enough.
Watcher's Patch.Name: Watcher's Patch

Haki Haori.Description: Pale mint cloth flecked like sea spray, worn by fighters who would rather let silence do the announcing.
Haki Haori.Name: Haki Haori

Firstlight Spear.Name: Firstlight Spear
Firstlight Spear.Description: Firstlight work at the head of a long shaft, made to order and made to be taken back to the forge again.

Firstlight War Fans.Name: Firstlight War Fans
Firstlight War Fans.Description: Pale Firstlight ribs carrying Cryokinesis in folded arcs, cut from set stock and finished entirely by hand.

Bamboo Sandogasa.Name: Bamboo Sandogasa
Bamboo Sandogasa.Description: A domed bamboo hat marked with a white cross, layered until no daylight reaches the head beneath it.

Panther Jaw Mask.Description: A bone jaw with its teeth still bared, worn along one cheek. It belonged to something that hunted like a big cat and called itself a king.
Panther Jaw Mask.Name: Panther Jaw Mask

Wind Trainer.Description: Saneri's trainer gear has no spare cloth on it, only hard lines and room for the next slash.
Wind Trainer.Name: Wind Trainer

Damascus Shotgun.Name: Damascus Shotgun
Damascus Shotgun.Description: Violet chasing over a heavy double barrel, built for buckshot rushes, point blank holds, and frantic follow through.

Sakura Erimaki.Description: Soft pink winter cloth, stitched with blossom motifs for those who carry spring into the snow.
Sakura Erimaki.Name: Sakura Erimaki

Dragon Kesa.Description: Coarse brown cloth draped and belted at one shoulder, its dragon mark worn nearly smooth. Iceveil pikemen favor it on the road.
Dragon Kesa.Name: Dragon Kesa

Firstlight Katana Schematic.Description: Plans for a long blade, the edge sketched against a sunrise so the curve could be checked by its light.
Firstlight Katana Schematic.Name: Firstlight Katana Schematic

Gemstone.Description: Betty's river lost gemstone, washed clean by Bamboo Grove water and too personal to leave in the mud.
Gemstone.Name: Gemstone

Feathered Cape.Name: Feathered Cape
Feathered Cape.Description: Elara's deep blue cape, thick with white fur at the collar, cut for the wind that comes off Mistfall Harbor.

Lost Cape.Name: Lost Cape
Lost Cape.Description: A dark red cape from the Lost set, its hem flaring bright as caught firelight whenever the wearer turns.

Reaper’s Outfit.Name: Reaper’s Outfit
Reaper’s Outfit.Description: Reaper's coat hangs like a silent bell, cut to move before the sound of the scythe reaches the ear.

Mushroom Lit Lantern.Name: Mushroom Lit Lantern
Mushroom Lit Lantern.Description: Blue cave mushrooms light this case from inside. Their own glow keeps hidden caps visible where other lamps drive them under.

Serpent Haori.Name: Serpent Haori
Serpent Haori.Description: Obari's haori, banded black and white down its whole length, kept close to a body that never moves in a straight line.

Damascus Tanto.Name: Damascus Tanto
Damascus Tanto.Description: A short blade sunk in violet, suited to phantom rushes, spiral cuts, and drops from above.

Claws.Name: Claws
Claws.Description: Hooked demon claws built for close reversals, turning a staggered moment into a savage counter and chase.

Silent Vesture.Name: Silent Vesture
Silent Vesture.Description: Layered vesture with a muffled hem, the kind Mistfall duelists choose when footfalls matter.

Enryu Katana.Name: Enryu Katana
Enryu Katana.Description: A long blade of pale lilac steel over a red wrapped grip, issued to slayers ready to put a Breathing style to real work.

Firstlight Haori Schematic.Description: A haori pattern taken off clothes that came back from the wrong place, the one cut no tailor teaches.
Firstlight Haori Schematic.Name: Firstlight Haori Schematic

Frozen Heart.Description: The Yeti's frozen heart, cut away from the beast. Return it to the berg and the ice wakes.
Frozen Heart.Name: Frozen Heart

Horse.Description: Calls a rideable horse for the open road. It changes gait while moving, jumps from solid ground, and dismounts on command.
Horse.Name: Horse

Ninja Headband.Description: Black cloth wound tight and knotted behind, its tails left long enough to snap in the wind.
Ninja Headband.Name: Ninja Headband

Solstice Necklace.Name: Solstice Necklace
Solstice Necklace.Description: Gold worked into a small sun, kept for the longest nights, warm at the edge and dark at the core.

Nichirin Lantern.Name: Nichirin Lantern
Nichirin Lantern.Description: A back lantern polished to the pale sheen of Corps steel, made to keep the dark from closing in.

Ore.Description: Bright trade ore accepted at special counters, stamped with no mint but trusted when ordinary coin will not do.
Ore.Name: Ore

Frostsilk Topper.Description: A pale blue brim under a lighter band, stocked in the settlement for people with more coin than winter sense.
Frostsilk Topper.Name: Frostsilk Topper

Clear Wind Hakama.Description: Pale hakama that move cleanly in a gale, with cuffs kept narrow for hill paths and sudden footwork.
Clear Wind Hakama.Name: Clear Wind Hakama

Demonic Horns.Name: Demonic Horns
Demonic Horns.Description: A pair of jagged black horns, worn by fighters who would rather be feared than recognized.

Kamon Sodenashi.Description: Sleeveless cloth marked with family crests, careful work for someone who still remembers where they came from.
Kamon Sodenashi.Name: Kamon Sodenashi

Large Gourd.Name: Large Gourd
Large Gourd.Description: Large Estate gourd for practiced lungs. Blowing it out spends the vessel and advances Slayer breathing discipline.

Silent Vesture Top Hat.Name: Silent Vesture Top Hat
Silent Vesture Top Hat.Description: A tall black hat hung with a violet chain, matched to a coat meant for crossing a room unremembered.

Wood Backpack.Description: Slatted wood and rough straps, made for hauling small burdens over mountain roads without complaint.
Wood Backpack.Name: Wood Backpack

Sun Eve Drape.Description: Pale blue and hooded, cut for the hour before the sun comes up. Bought for the look of a long watch rather than for having stood one.
Sun Eve Drape.Name: Sun Eve Drape

Shades.Description: Smoke dark lenses better suited to market alleys than mountain roads, keeping the wearer's gaze unreadable either way.
Shades.Name: Shades

Lost Shotgun.Name: Lost Shotgun
Lost Shotgun.Description: The Lost Slayer's gun, red lacquer over brass and still smelling of drowned powder, built for recoil rushes and close blasts.

Ghost Attendant Outfit.Name: Ghost Attendant Outfit
Ghost Attendant Outfit.Description: White cloth for a shrine helper who forgot to leave, quiet at the sleeves and colder than it should be.

Serpent Katana.Name: Serpent Katana
Serpent Katana.Description: Obari's Nichirin trails coiling violet light, turning a narrow guard into a trap for the first overreach.

Himawari Kesa.Description: Sunflower dye warms this kesa, a field bright cloth that looks out of place under demon haunted eaves.
Himawari Kesa.Name: Himawari Kesa

Axe and Mace.Name: Axe and Mace
Axe and Mace.Description: A chained axe and mace for Stone Breathing, heavy enough that each step feels like a vow to stand firm.

Moonveil Fox Mask.Description: Pale fox lacquer with a moon at the brow, hiding rather more wear than its graceful shape lets on.
Moonveil Fox Mask.Name: Moonveil Fox Mask

Jewelry Box.Description: Ginzo's jewelry box from Hidden Mist. Keep it in hand, or the road sends you back for it.
Jewelry Box.Name: Jewelry Box

Shinkage Katana.Name: Shinkage Katana
Shinkage Katana.Description: Indigo tempered steel from the same forge as the issued blades, quiet in the hand and severe at the edge.

kagura Hat.Description: A red kagura band with a white panel marked in black zigzags, its tails left long for the turn of the dance.
kagura Hat.Name: kagura Hat

Hishigata Sodenashi.Name: Hishigata Sodenashi
Hishigata Sodenashi.Description: Old hishi diamonds banded across a sleeveless green coat, cut for guards who would rather take a blow on the forearm than give ground.

Bandaged Eyepatch.Description: Field linen wound over a ruined eye, clean enough to keep wearing and stained enough to keep remembering.
Bandaged Eyepatch.Name: Bandaged Eyepatch

Hiyozu's Bottom.Name: Hiyozu's Bottom
Hiyozu's Bottom.Description: Hiyozu's wrapped trousers are scuffed at the knees, made for a reaper who fought low and close.

Ninja Scroll.Description: A sealed scroll case lashed for quick travel, its cord darkened by rain, smoke, and hurried hands.
Ninja Scroll.Name: Ninja Scroll

Nightfall Mask Schematic.Description: Plans for a mask with no eye holes at all, and a note in the margin saying it does not need them.
Nightfall Mask Schematic.Name: Nightfall Mask Schematic

Reverb Cleavers.Name: Reverb Cleavers
Reverb Cleavers.Description: Twin cleavers tuned by the tower forge. Even their dents seem to hold the last strike's echo.

Lost Shotgun Schematic.Description: Plans for a short gun in red lacquer over brass, the recoil drawn as a step forward rather than a fault to brace against.
Lost Shotgun Schematic.Name: Lost Shotgun Schematic

Regular Katana.Name: Regular Katana
Regular Katana.Description: Plain Nichirin for any Breathing style, serviceable and honest, with wear from unrecorded patrols.

Black Dragon Tail.Description: A long crimson tail ending in a blade, strapped on by people who want their silhouette read as something other than human.
Black Dragon Tail.Name: Black Dragon Tail

Fujiko’s Outfit.Name: Fujiko’s Outfit
Fujiko’s Outfit.Description: Fujiko's navy robe scattered with gold clouds over black trousers, kept with the same care as the parasol that goes with it.

Star Eye Patch.Description: A gold star stitched onto black, turning a dressing into a small and deliberate banner of defiance.
Star Eye Patch.Name: Star Eye Patch

Stylish Glasses.Description: Narrow red lenses that hide exactly which way he is looking, which is of course the entire point of them.
Stylish Glasses.Name: Stylish Glasses

Cooked Bear Meat.Description: Smoked bear meat from Lucy's pantry. Eating it restores health and quickens recovery for a short while.
Cooked Bear Meat.Name: Cooked Bear Meat

Black Amigasa.Description: Lacquered black and gilded with cranes, slung on red cords. Ornate for a bandit's hat, and still shade enough to keep the sun off.
Black Amigasa.Name: Black Amigasa

Thunder Necklace.Name: Thunder Necklace
Thunder Necklace.Description: A gold bolt on black cord, hung the way lightning looks in the instant just before it is gone.

Letter.Description: Noote's decoded letter, folded tight for Chaka and carrying news the bandits hoped would stay buried.
Letter.Name: Letter

Pentacle Necklace.Description: A silver chain with a five-pointed pendant, the mark of an old line of archers who drew their bows from light alone. They were proud to the last.
Pentacle Necklace.Name: Pentacle Necklace

Howling Bandana.Description: A pale bandana knotted tight at the back, worn by a brawler from the lowest district who howls at anyone stronger.
Howling Bandana.Name: Howling Bandana

Suspicious Note.Description: Evidence taken from village spies, written in careful code and useless after Noote has read it.
Suspicious Note.Name: Suspicious Note

Heart of Night Earrings.Name: Heart of Night Earrings
Heart of Night Earrings.Description: Small black wings holding a drop of magenta crystal, the sort of night work nobody leaves out on display.

Package.Description: Farmer's brown paper parcel for Elara, tied against harbor damp and carried until she opens her shop.
Package.Name: Package

Frostgrey Traveler's Coat.Description: A heavy brown traveling coat over a collared shirt, cut for Iceveil roads and the long waits between them.
Frostgrey Traveler's Coat.Name: Frostgrey Traveler's Coat

Fujiko's Lantern.Name: Fujiko's Lantern
Fujiko's Lantern.Description: Fujiko's lantern, navy lacquer under gold clouds, keeping a duelist's light steady through rain and shaken ground.

Lone Horn Helm.Description: A broken white helm with a single long horn curving from one side. Whoever wore it insisted they had no heart, and kept asking what one was.
Lone Horn Helm.Name: Lone Horn Helm

Nightfall Weaver's Cloth.Description: Heavy cloth woven for Nightfall gear, dark enough that frost and ash both leave their marks.
Nightfall Weaver's Cloth.Name: Nightfall Weaver's Cloth

Raimon Erimaki.Description: A thunder pattern scarf from Iceveil looms, yellow lines flashing through storm gray wool.
Raimon Erimaki.Name: Raimon Erimaki

Underwater Breathing Potion.Name: Underwater Breathing Potion
Underwater Breathing Potion.Description: Briny draught for deep dives. Drink it and your breath lasts longer beneath the water.

Firstlight War Fans Schematic.Description: Plans for a matched pair of iron fans, every leaf numbered so the two open on the same beat.
Firstlight War Fans Schematic.Name: Firstlight War Fans Schematic

Checkered Haori.Name: Checkered Haori
Checkered Haori.Description: Checkerboard cloth in a charcoal seller's colors, worn soft where the sleeves swing over a blade.

Nightfall Serpent Katana Schematic.Description: Plans for a blade that waves down its whole length, each bend numbered so the smith cannot straighten one by habit.
Nightfall Serpent Katana Schematic.Name: Nightfall Serpent Katana Schematic

Mimic Earrings.Name: Mimic Earrings
Mimic Earrings.Description: Plain gold bars that hang like ornament and read like ornament, right up until the lamp catches the seam.

Nightfall Axe and Mace.Name: Nightfall Axe and Mace
Nightfall Axe and Mace.Description: A gilded axe and a spiked weight on one chain, set work built to hold a line long after sunset has gone.

Water Necklace.Name: Water Necklace
Water Necklace.Description: A blue drop that never quite falls, threaded for hands that would rather keep their cuts flowing.

Shopkeeper's Hat.Description: A green and white striped bucket hat worn low over the eyes. It suits a sweets seller in wooden clogs who always knows more than they say.
Shopkeeper's Hat.Name: Shopkeeper's Hat

Cutlass.Name: Cutlass
Cutlass.Description: Zuko's short curved blade favors close work, opening with a double cut and a quick-draw flurry when space runs out.

Kasumi Yukata.Description: Mist patterned yukata faded at the sleeves, as if the cloth spent too many mornings near cold water.
Kasumi Yukata.Name: Kasumi Yukata

Monster Hood.Name: Monster Hood
Monster Hood.Description: A snarling red beast's head with its fangs bared, pulled on by fighters who plant themselves and let the blows come.

Olive Flower Haori.Description: Olive cloth scattered with small blossoms, plain enough for market days and sturdy enough for patrol.
Olive Flower Haori.Name: Olive Flower Haori

Thundercloud Katana.Name: Thundercloud Katana
Thundercloud Katana.Description: Storm dark steel that throws blue arcs down the edge, carrying the hush that comes before a Thunder draw.

Silver Fang Mask.Name: Silver Fang Mask
Silver Fang Mask.Description: Gray steel teeth that catch torchlight first, warning the room that the wearer means to press every opening.

Abyssal Lantern.Name: Abyssal Lantern
Abyssal Lantern.Description: A violet lamp in a spined black frame, its glow sitting deep and heavy, like light seen from under still water.

Nightfall Mask.Name: Nightfall Mask
Nightfall Mask.Description: Horned set metal wound over with bandages, taking in campfire light and giving back none of it.

Emberheart Lantern.Description: Its ember holds off Iceveil's freeze while it burns, then must be rekindled beside a campfire.
Emberheart Lantern.Name: Emberheart Lantern

Overdrive Necklace.Name: Overdrive Necklace
Overdrive Necklace.Description: A violet star on a short cord, made for fighters who burn through their own calm far too quickly.

Sickles.Name: Sickles
Sickles.Description: Hoyuzo's twin blades are ugly with use. Blood Manipulation rides them as execution runs and tearing vortexes.

Water Katana.Name: Water Katana
Water Katana.Description: Giyen's blade throws white water along the cut, passing through and leaving very little argument behind.

Desert Prowler Outfit.Description: A white jacket left open over a bare stomach, belted with a dark sash above loose white hakama. Cut for a prowler who meant to be king of the whole desert.
Desert Prowler Outfit.Name: Desert Prowler Outfit

Firstlight Lantern.Name: Firstlight Lantern
Firstlight Lantern.Description: A gilded set lamp built around star ore, laying a dawn pale road through the deepest dark the tower has.

Damascus Claws.Name: Damascus Claws
Damascus Claws.Description: Violet plated claws with a hungry curve, sharpened for the brutal reversal and the pursuit that follows.

Tengoku Katana.Name: Tengoku Katana
Tengoku Katana.Description: A white blade dressed in red and blue flowerwork, kept nearer to a shrine treasure than a working weapon.

Datai's Outfit.Name: Datai's Outfit
Datai's Outfit.Description: Datai's sashwork outfit still holds the crease of long reaches, as if the cloth remembers how to snare.

Ying Yang Haori.Description: Black and white halves meet in a careful seam, a coat for those who distrust simple answers.
Ying Yang Haori.Name: Ying Yang Haori

Flame Haori Style 1.Name: Flame Haori Style 1
Flame Haori Style 1.Description: The Flame school's other cut, its fire worked short and tight at the hem, made for precise hands rather than the loudest in the room.

OuwFish.Description: Everyday Mistfall catch, plain enough for crates but welcome wherever supper has to stretch.
OuwFish.Name: OuwFish

Black-Cord Necklace.Name: Black-Cord Necklace
Black-Cord Necklace.Description: Knotted cord and two dull rings, the quiet charm a cautious trader keeps under the collar.

Sumari's Outfit.Name: Sumari's Outfit
Sumari's Outfit.Description: Sumari's outfit keeps its round, playful trim, a cruel costume for a game no child survives.

Fish Head.Description: Sour bait that draws better bites and is spent when the line resolves. Fit it to a rod that can hold brighter fish.
Fish Head.Name: Fish Head

Chained Glasses.Description: Round gold lenses on a fine chain, the habit of someone who has already lost one good pair to a bad road.
Chained Glasses.Name: Chained Glasses

White Hooded Haori.Name: White Hooded Haori
White Hooded Haori.Description: A white hooded cloak shading to pale blue along its ragged hem, made to hide a tired face without hiding a drawn blade.

Ashura’s Mask.Name: Ashura’s Mask
Ashura’s Mask.Description: Two gilt faces on one strap, one serene and one furious, so the wearer can decide which the room gets.

Black Lotus Crown.Name: Black Lotus Crown
Black Lotus Crown.Description: Domae's black crown, gilded at every edge and trailing pale ribbons. It came off his head still cold.

Red Oni Mask.Name: Red Oni Mask
Red Oni Mask.Description: Red lacquer, gold horns, bared teeth. It asks for forward pressure and ugly trades at arm's length.

Reaper Necklace.Name: Reaper Necklace
Reaper Necklace.Description: The Reaper's own blue flame, cold at the edge, traded among climbers who favor quick endings.

Blood Manipulation Necklace.Name: Blood Manipulation Necklace
Blood Manipulation Necklace.Description: A single red drop on a cord, never quite drying, for fighters who treat every cut as a promise.

Monster Ears.Description: Soft tan ears on a simple band. Village children wear them, and so do a surprising number of slayers.
Monster Ears.Name: Monster Ears

Gleam Eyepatch.Description: A dark eyepatch set with a pink stone, worn over whatever the wearer has stopped explaining.
Gleam Eyepatch.Name: Gleam Eyepatch

Lycoris Haori.Name: Lycoris Haori
Lycoris Haori.Description: Grave flower red blooms across this haori, funeral bright and favored by fighters who expect the worst.

Mask of Memories.Description: Layered paper and lacquer holding the shape of a face somebody could not stand to let go of.
Mask of Memories.Name: Mask of Memories

Nightfall Sickles.Name: Nightfall Sickles
Nightfall Sickles.Description: Paired set sickles that drink torchlight along the curve, made for Blood Manipulation and the reaper's spinning rush.

Lost Outfit.Name: Lost Outfit
Lost Outfit.Description: Cloth from the Lost set, faded like it spent too long in Final Selection fog and came back without its owner.

Firstlight Sound Cleavers.Name: Firstlight Sound Cleavers
Firstlight Sound Cleavers.Description: Paired Firstlight cleavers behind heavy gold guards, loud and close, and still owed more work than they have had.

Insect Trainer.Description: Shinora's training outfit is kept light and clean, with sleeves cut clear for needle fast forms.
Insect Trainer.Name: Insect Trainer

Dream Orb.Description: A drowsy pulse moves inside. Crush it to open Dream core training, where sleep and flesh take the same shape.
Dream Orb.Name: Dream Orb

Small Gourd.Description: Small clay gourd for early breathing drills. A full blow spends it and adds to Slayer training.
Small Gourd.Name: Small Gourd

Water Trainer.Description: Urokodaki's weathered robe smells of cedar smoke and river spray, the uniform of a patient teacher.
Water Trainer.Name: Water Trainer

Envoy of Night Mask.Name: Envoy of Night Mask
Envoy of Night Mask.Description: A long beaked mask in night lacquer, copied from a foreign physician's design out of an age that blamed bad air for everything.

Black Dragon Horns.Description: Deep red horns that curl back like a dragon's. All theatre, and worn by people who know it.
Black Dragon Horns.Name: Black Dragon Horns

Thunder Trainer.Description: Zentaro's training coat is neat as a held breath, yellow cloth ready to vanish into a sudden step.
Thunder Trainer.Name: Thunder Trainer

Firstlight Mask Schematic.Description: Plans for a mask, the eye holes cut where the first light of the day would land.
Firstlight Mask Schematic.Name: Firstlight Mask Schematic

Metal Scraps.Description: Bent fittings and broken blade bits, saved for the forge when a recipe asks for plain metal.
Metal Scraps.Name: Metal Scraps

Fighting Style.Name: Fighting Style
Fighting Style.Description: A persistent fist form that carries any learned fighting style, keeping its place as teachers and forms change.

Slayer Uniform.Description: Final Selection issue, plain Corps cloth that marks a survivor and is never meant for a demon's keeping.
Slayer Uniform.Name: Slayer Uniform

Basic Fishing Rod.Description: A plain permit rod for Mistfall's everyday catch. Its line can be refined, but it will not truly reach deep water.
Basic Fishing Rod.Name: Basic Fishing Rod

Whispering Winds Earrings.Name: Whispering Winds Earrings
Whispering Winds Earrings.Description: Curved silver cradling a pale blue bead, keeping a thread of moving air pressed close to the ear.

Crow.Description: Calls a Kasugai crow to perch nearby and bring Corps hunt orders. A click sends it back into the sky.
Crow.Name: Crow

Volcanic Katana.Name: Volcanic Katana
Volcanic Katana.Description: Blackened red steel that keeps an open flame along the edge, as though it were drawn straight from a mountain's mouth.

Silk Thread.Description: Strong thread stripped from salvage, kept for recipes that need cloth to hold through a fighter's wear.
Silk Thread.Name: Silk Thread

Refinement Guard x5.Description: Bundled guard scrolls for the forge. Each scroll keeps bad refinement from pulling steel backward.
Refinement Guard x5.Name: Refinement Guard x5

Blossom Crest Haori.Description: Pale noble cloth marked with a blossom crest and lined in gold. The house that wears it counts its petals in the thousands and never lets one fall out of place.
Blossom Crest Haori.Name: Blossom Crest Haori

Hem stripe Kata-Aki.Description: Broad purple bands run the hem and cuffs of this white shoulder cloth, practical enough for cold roads and crowded ferries.
Hem stripe Kata-Aki.Name: Hem stripe Kata-Aki

Nightfall Top Schematic.Description: Plans for a crossed top, every seam laid out against the other Nightfall drawings so the set closes as one.
Nightfall Top Schematic.Name: Nightfall Top Schematic

Wagwan's Ring.Description: Wagwan's misplaced ring, cave dust in the setting and panic in every scratch.
Wagwan's Ring.Name: Wagwan's Ring

Coral.Description: Salt hardened coral snapped from harbor rock, traded by fish buyers and worked into sea scarred gear.
Coral.Name: Coral

Frozen Heart Cache x5.Description: Weighty cache that yields bundled Frozen Hearts for repeated returns to the berg.
Frozen Heart Cache x5.Name: Frozen Heart Cache x5

Karakusa Cloak.Name: Karakusa Cloak
Karakusa Cloak.Description: Vine scrollwork curls in gold across deep violet, its travel wear hidden in the looping pattern.

Feather Tassel.Name: Feather Tassel
Feather Tassel.Description: A gilt lozenge trailing red and white feathers, still smelling faintly of the roadside smoke it travelled through.

Fern Weave Hakama.Description: Fern woven hakama suited to damp paths, light enough to dry beside a fisherman's fire.
Fern Weave Hakama.Name: Fern Weave Hakama

Twilight Haori.Name: Twilight Haori
Twilight Haori.Description: The haori of the Slayer Corps' head, dusk shading into still water at the lining. Whoever wears it is not expected to draw, only to be stood behind.

Bamboo Muzzle.Name: Bamboo Muzzle
Bamboo Muzzle.Description: The bamboo Nezura bites down on. It is not a gag so much as a promise she keeps every day she does not break it.

Fractured Web Kata-Aki.Name: Fractured Web Kata-Aki
Fractured Web Kata-Aki.Description: Red webbing cracks across black cloth, each broken line pulled taut like a snare set in the tower dark.

Nezura's Outfit.Name: Nezura's Outfit
Nezura's Outfit.Description: Nezura's pink kimono under a dark haori, its hemp leaf pattern worn soft. She has not taken it off since the night she changed.

Fire Demon Outfit.Description: Charred rig cloth from Iceveil's fire demons, patched where thrown flame burned back through the sleeve.
Fire Demon Outfit.Name: Fire Demon Outfit

Insect Katana.Name: Insect Katana
Insect Katana.Description: A slender blade that throws violet and gold sparks, trading chopping weight for the needle work of the Insect school.

Nightfall Serpent Katana.Name: Nightfall Serpent Katana
Nightfall Serpent Katana.Description: A rippling Nightfall blade that waves down its whole length, turning every angle into one the eye arrives at late.

Drowned Lure.Description: Knotted lure from Isao's lost line. It is not spent by the bite, and the river favors empty reels around it.
Drowned Lure.Name: Drowned Lure

Permit Stamp.Description: Sofen's missing stamp from the docks. Keep it in hand, or the permit errand starts over.
Permit Stamp.Name: Permit Stamp

Serpent Key.Description: A wet iron key, green at the bow. Somewhere near the water there is a lock it was cut for, and a great many it was not.
Serpent Key.Name: Serpent Key

Muzan's Blood.Description: Muzan's sealed flask, meant for Humans only. Drinking it locks the body and remakes it as a Demon.
Muzan's Blood.Name: Muzan's Blood

Nightfall Bottom Schematic.Description: Plans for the trousers under the crossed top, cut to the same green as the rest of the set.
Nightfall Bottom Schematic.Name: Nightfall Bottom Schematic

Wind Slayer Uniform.Name: Wind Slayer Uniform
Wind Slayer Uniform.Description: Saneri's open jacket is wind scoured at the edges, made for a Hashira who cuts straight through the gale.

Kaiden's Top.Name: Kaiden's Top
Kaiden's Top.Description: Kaiden's ragged top leaves the arms free, bandit cloth made for gauntlets rather than ceremony.

Cherry Blossom Lantern.Description: A paper lantern that burns warm orange behind a painted blossom branch, light enough to walk a road after dusk.
Cherry Blossom Lantern.Name: Cherry Blossom Lantern

Lantern of Despair.Name: Lantern of Despair
Lantern of Despair.Description: Worn brass stamped with a single character, giving so thin a light that the snow only feels farther from dawn.

Happy Chaos Shades.Description: Two orange crosses where the eyes should be. Worn by the sort who finds all of this funny and is still the most dangerous man present.
Happy Chaos Shades.Name: Happy Chaos Shades

Sweet Dreams Eye Mask.Description: Soft blue fabric scented faintly of sleep herbs, carried by travelers who rest in the gaps between alarms.
Sweet Dreams Eye Mask.Name: Sweet Dreams Eye Mask

Black Monster Ears.Description: Black pointed ears lined with pale fur, for travelers who would rather be mistaken for something else.
Black Monster Ears.Name: Black Monster Ears

Golden Tentacle.Description: Gleaming tentacle bait that draws the deepest bites. Each resolved bite spends bait from the stack.
Golden Tentacle.Name: Golden Tentacle

Ice Demon Outfit.Description: Frost stiff rig cloth from Iceveil's ice demons, its seams pale where cold bolts burst too close.
Ice Demon Outfit.Name: Ice Demon Outfit

Medium Gourd.Name: Medium Gourd
Medium Gourd.Description: Mid-sized training gourd. A steady breath consumes it and pushes a Slayer's practice onward.

Firstlight Bladed Wagasa.Name: Firstlight Bladed Wagasa
Firstlight Bladed Wagasa.Description: A gilded canopy on a Firstlight frame, ragged at the hem. Shade for a demon, and a hidden edge for whoever stands too near it.

Azure Drape Scarf.Name: Azure Drape Scarf
Azure Drape Scarf.Description: A deep navy drape scattered with frost, long enough to pull across the face when the weather turns against you.

Black Dragon Armour.Name: Black Dragon Armour
Black Dragon Armour.Description: A sleeveless cuirass of black dragon scale under a purple scarf, worn close to the body where heavier plate would cost a turn.

Stone Trainer.Description: Gyorei's trainer robe hangs like temple cloth over a weapon stance, steady before any swing begins.
Stone Trainer.Name: Stone Trainer

Nightfall Katana Schematic.Description: Plans for a long blade, inked so dark the edge can only be found by tilting the page.
Nightfall Katana Schematic.Name: Nightfall Katana Schematic

Ninja Fang Scarf.Name: Ninja Fang Scarf
Ninja Fang Scarf.Description: A deep blue scarf cut to points along the hem, kept short so it will never snag during quiet work.

Firstlight Top Schematic.Description: Plans for a pale top, every seam laid out against the other Firstlight drawings so the set closes as one.
Firstlight Top Schematic.Name: Firstlight Top Schematic

Mocking Mask.Description: A blue and white grin that has outlived several owners, each of them certain the next blade would pass them by.
Mocking Mask.Name: Mocking Mask

Health Elixir.Description: A richer healing draught from Meku's shelf. Drinking it closes deeper wounds than the field bottle can manage.
Health Elixir.Name: Health Elixir

Stamina Regen Potion.Name: Stamina Regen Potion
Stamina Regen Potion.Description: Thin stimulant for spent lungs and legs. Drink it to quicken stamina recovery for a brief push.

Mandala Kata-Aki.Name: Mandala Kata-Aki
Mandala Kata-Aki.Description: Mandala rings are inked across the shoulder, steadying the eye before steel leaves the sheath.

Cryokinesis Orb.Description: Frost beads beneath the shell. Squeezing it begins Cryokinesis core training for a core not yet claimed.
Cryokinesis Orb.Name: Cryokinesis Orb

Gyutai's Outfit.Name: Gyutai's Outfit
Gyutai's Outfit.Description: Gyutai's patched clothing smells of iron rain, the fabric slit where blood sickles learned their path.

Black Sandogasa.Description: A dark segmented traveling hat gathered under a white cloth tie. It sheds rain and hides a face.
Black Sandogasa.Name: Black Sandogasa

Ivory edge Cloak.Description: A short ivory cloak clasped at the throat, the kind a night trader keeps folded until the path is empty.
Ivory edge Cloak.Name: Ivory edge Cloak

Pyrokinesis Necklace.Name: Pyrokinesis Necklace
Pyrokinesis Necklace.Description: A violet flame caught on the cord, for blood arts that answer like fire and give none of its warmth.

Exile's Haori.Description: A loose charcoal haori with a single row of white diamonds. It once belonged to a captain turned inventor, exiled over one invention, who never stopped tinkering.
Exile's Haori.Name: Exile's Haori

Flame Amigasa.Name: Flame Amigasa
Flame Amigasa.Description: A straw amigasa finished in scalloped white trim with tassels left hanging, close woven enough to turn daylight aside.

Krathulon.Description: Long bodied deep catch with a jaw like a dock cleat. Iceveil stores prize it because it keeps through cold travel.
Krathulon.Name: Krathulon

Firstlight Insect Katana Schematic.Description: Plans for a thin blade, the point drawn over and over until it was narrow enough to sting.
Firstlight Insect Katana Schematic.Name: Firstlight Insect Katana Schematic

Gleam Headband.Name: Gleam Headband
Gleam Headband.Description: Tengai's banded headpiece, set with cut stones and hung with a bead chain, worn low so nothing shifts mid rhythm.

Ocean Wave Katana.Name: Ocean Wave Katana
Ocean Wave Katana.Description: A coastal smith's katana, named for the wave its temper line traces rather than for anything it does in the hand.

Heavenly Crown.Name: Heavenly Crown
Heavenly Crown.Description: A crown of dark spines rather than gold, the kind of thing carved for a figure nobody living has actually met.

Panther Mask.Name: Panther Mask
Panther Mask.Description: White lacquer following a panther's jawline, made for fighters who take the hit and keep closing anyway.

Crude Iron Ingot.Description: Issued after Final Selection, this rough iron lets the armory fit a new Slayer with a Nichirin blade.
Crude Iron Ingot.Name: Crude Iron Ingot

Urokodaki's Mask.Name: Urokodaki's Mask
Urokodaki's Mask.Description: The tengu face Urokodaki carves by hand, one for every child he sends up that mountain hoping to see them come back.

Bandaged Mask.Description: The wrapping Obari never takes off. Ask about it once and you will not get an answer, or a second chance to ask.
Bandaged Mask.Name: Bandaged Mask

Flame Trainer.Description: Rengu's teaching coat is kept soot brushed and plain, so students watch the footwork instead of the cloth.
Flame Trainer.Name: Flame Trainer

Pyrokenesis Orb.Description: Heat crawls under the shell. Crush it to begin Pyrokenesis core training before the flame leaks away.
Pyrokenesis Orb.Name: Pyrokenesis Orb

Squid Beanie.Description: A deep red squid worn as a cap with its tentacles left to hang, the sort of prize a harbor stall gives for a good haul.
Squid Beanie.Name: Squid Beanie

Health Regen Elixir.Name: Health Regen Elixir
Health Regen Elixir.Description: Slow, clean medicine that quickens the body's mending for a longer stretch after the drink.

Everburn Lantern.Description: A sealed winter lantern whose flame never spends itself, keeping Iceveil's freeze from taking hold.
Everburn Lantern.Name: Everburn Lantern

Uzumaki Yukata.Description: Spiral dyed yukata whose pattern draws the eye inward, popular with travelers who listen before they speak.
Uzumaki Yukata.Name: Uzumaki Yukata

Thunder Katana.Name: Thunder Katana
Thunder Katana.Description: Zentaro's Nichirin is bright at the tip and restless in the scabbard, waiting on the instant before thunder.

Wind Necklace.Name: Wind Necklace
Wind Necklace.Description: Feather light beads on a restless cord, always turning toward the next draft.

Yahari Outfit.Description: Yahari's arrow marked robes sit narrow at the sleeves, made for a demon who turns force without touching it.
Yahari Outfit.Name: Yahari Outfit

Zhou Yu Helmet.Name: Zhou Yu Helmet
Zhou Yu Helmet.Description: A commander's kabuto, dark red under a great gold crest. It was never issued to anyone who had to earn it.

Hiyozu's Top.Name: Hiyozu's Top
Hiyozu's Top.Description: Hiyozu's top binds tight across the ribs, leaving the arms free for sickle work.

Blood Manipulation Orb.Description: Half full of something that moves like blood and settles like it too. Crush it in a demon's hand to open Blood Manipulation core training.
Blood Manipulation Orb.Name: Blood Manipulation Orb

Wind Earrings.Name: Wind Earrings
Wind Earrings.Description: Worn brass discs hung with long pale feathers that turn at the smallest movement of air.

Tidal Earrings.Name: Tidal Earrings
Tidal Earrings.Description: Paired spheres, one dark and one pale, polished the way the tide finishes anything left on the shore.

Sakura Felt Hat.Description: Blossom pink felt with a spray of pale flowers at the band, an odd thing to find on a shelf this far north.
Sakura Felt Hat.Name: Sakura Felt Hat

Clan Skills.Name: Clan Skills
Clan Skills.Description: A bloodline tool that appears only for clans with techniques, drawing the right clan skills without needing a separate weapon.

Stone Slayer Uniform.Name: Stone Slayer Uniform
Stone Slayer Uniform.Description: Gyorei's Corps uniform is broad and solemn, prayer worn cloth for the heaviest work.

Shotgun Schematic.Description: Water stained plans from a lost Slayer's weapon, still clear enough for a gunsmith to copy.
Shotgun Schematic.Name: Shotgun Schematic

Firstlight Katana.Name: Firstlight Katana
Firstlight Katana.Description: White and gold set steel, smithed to order rather than found. Heavy at the guard and balanced for holding ground until dawn.

Refinement Ore.Description: Plain refinement ore fed to the forge, also smelted into stronger stone when a blade outgrows it.
Refinement Ore.Name: Refinement Ore

Yozakura Yukata.Description: Pale lavender scattered with night cherry, cut for harbor walks once the lamps along the water are lit.
Yozakura Yukata.Name: Yozakura Yukata

Reaper Orb.Description: Hollow as a little moon, it opens Reaper core training when squeezed by blood not yet pledged to an art.
Reaper Orb.Name: Reaper Orb

Heart of Night Necklace.Name: Heart of Night Necklace
Heart of Night Necklace.Description: Black wings folded around a magenta stone, the badge the Tai Chi students wear and never leave out in daylight.

Zhou Yu Armour.Name: Zhou Yu Armour
Zhou Yu Armour.Description: Zhou Yu's armour is a commander's relic, too complete for ordinary war and too polished for honest peace.

Yamamichi Kimono.Description: Mountain road kimono with a padded waist, patterned for travelers who have learned to sleep beside cold stones.
Yamamichi Kimono.Name: Yamamichi Kimono

Eye Sash.Description: A narrow red sash tied as a vow, favored by fighters who would rather listen to a room than look at it.
Eye Sash.Name: Eye Sash

Nightfall Bottom.Name: Nightfall Bottom
Nightfall Bottom.Description: Dark trousers trimmed in pale fur and gold, woven from Nightfall cloth and plating rather than bought from anybody.

Legendary Fishing Rod.Name: Legendary Fishing Rod
Legendary Fishing Rod.Description: Isao's handmade rod, raised from the river. It reaches sunken gear when other lines still find only fish.

Conductor's Cap.Description: A trainman's peaked cap, its brass button still bright, kept long after the line it belonged to stopped running.
Conductor's Cap.Name: Conductor's Cap

Broken Nichirin Katana.Description: Snapped Nichirin blade from a fallen Mizunoto, its edge gone dull but its duty not forgotten.
Broken Nichirin Katana.Name: Broken Nichirin Katana

Serpent Trainer.Description: Obari's trainer garb coils close to the body, leaving nothing loose for a blade or snake to catch.
Serpent Trainer.Name: Serpent Trainer

Damascus Scythe.Name: Damascus Scythe
Damascus Scythe.Description: A reaper's blade edged in violet, made for sweeping slashes and blood drunk lunges.

Crimson Necklace.Name: Crimson Necklace
Crimson Necklace.Description: One square red stone in a plain setting, the sort of charm found where old locks have rusted through.

Refinement Guard.Description: Insurance scroll for refinement. Burn it during an attempt to stop a bad result from lowering the blade.
Refinement Guard.Name: Refinement Guard

Seiun Kesa.Description: Blue cloud cloth draped against the cold, with a pale lining that catches lanternlight.
Seiun Kesa.Name: Seiun Kesa

Healing Gem Necklace.Name: Healing Gem Necklace
Healing Gem Necklace.Description: A green cross on worn silk, hung plain so the wounded know who to reach for first.

Domae's Bottom.Name: Domae's Bottom
Domae's Bottom.Description: Domae's white trousers are clean past reason, the cuffs stiff with frost from rooms that never thawed.

Kaiden's Bottom.Name: Kaiden's Bottom
Kaiden's Bottom.Description: Kaiden's trousers are cut above the ankle for bamboo mud, scuffed by quick turns and clawed footwork.

Stylish Boa.Name: Stylish Boa
Stylish Boa.Description: A shock of pink feathers worn with far more flourish than sense. Nobody stands behind one of these unnoticed.

Tamari Orb.Description: Warm and oddly heavy in the palm. Crush it to begin Tamari core training.
Tamari Orb.Name: Tamari Orb

Summer Night Mask.Description: An orange cat face hung with a bell, festival paint made for warm evenings and found speckled with frost.
Summer Night Mask.Name: Summer Night Mask

Tanto.Name: Tanto
Tanto.Description: Short Nichirin for close quarters, hiding phantom bursts, spiral bites, and a descent from the blind side.

Healing Gem Earrings.Name: Healing Gem Earrings
Healing Gem Earrings.Description: Green stones cut into a plain cross, the mark a field healer hangs where the wounded can find it.

Wisteria Greatcoat.Description: A pale greatcoat with a lavender scarf at the collar. Iceveil traders favor the shade for what wisteria means to demons, whatever the cloth itself does.
Wisteria Greatcoat.Name: Wisteria Greatcoat

Stylish Mask.Description: Shocking pink and cut into a grin. Subtlety was never anywhere on the list of objectives.
Stylish Mask.Name: Stylish Mask

Nightfall Gauntlet Schematic.Description: Plans for a pair of plated gauntlets, the knuckles drawn from three warriors' hands and none of them the same.
Nightfall Gauntlet Schematic.Name: Nightfall Gauntlet Schematic

Wind Haori.Name: Wind Haori
Wind Haori.Description: Saneri's haori, undyed and worn open at the front. The Wind school leaves nothing on the cloth that could slow a straight line through.

Spear.Name: Spear
Spear.Description: A road spear with enough reach to keep demons honest, built for storming rushes and clean pierces.

Enru's Top.Name: Enru's Top
Enru's Top.Description: Dream silk folds from Enru's coat, brushed smooth like a lullaby before the teeth show.

Golden Tentacle x75.Description: A bulk order of Golden Tentacle bait, enough to keep a line in deep water through a very long watch.
Golden Tentacle x75.Name: Golden Tentacle x75

Golden Kanzashi.Name: Golden Kanzashi
Golden Kanzashi.Description: Datai's hairpins, gold sticks spread with small pink fans, still set the way she wore them.

Stone Haori.Name: Stone Haori
Stone Haori.Description: Gyorei's olive haori, hung with square paper talismans, worn as a relic of Stone discipline rather than as a tailored coat.

Crimson Wrap Hakama.Description: Red wrapped hakama from frozen routes, their ties stained darker where hands tugged them tight in the cold.
Crimson Wrap Hakama.Name: Crimson Wrap Hakama

Shopkeeper's Garb.Description: Moss green work clothes with black trim, bound at the waist by a darker sash. Plain enough for minding a sweets shop, and for whatever goes on in the vast room beneath it.
Shopkeeper's Garb.Name: Shopkeeper's Garb

Crimson Earrings.Name: Crimson Earrings
Crimson Earrings.Description: Square red stones set flush in dark metal, favored by fighters who prefer their blood already named.

Flame Necklace.Name: Flame Necklace
Flame Necklace.Description: A pendant shaped as one rising flame, carrying its own small heat against the collarbone.

Obi Manipulation Necklace.Name: Obi Manipulation Necklace
Obi Manipulation Necklace.Description: A twist of obi silk knotted at the throat, the same binding Datai's art pulls tight around anyone slower.

Hollowfied Mask.Name: Hollowfied Mask
Hollowfied Mask.Description: Bone white and striped in red, the face that surfaces when a fighter stops arguing with the hollow thing inside and lets it cut.

Presence Hider Mask.Name: Presence Hider Mask
Presence Hider Mask.Description: Matte white that swallows shine and breath noise, so a room finds it hard to agree that anyone is standing there.

Wind Katana.Name: Wind Katana
Wind Katana.Description: Saneri's Nichirin is a deep green thing that drags the air into visible streaks behind every cut.

Firstlight Weaver's Silk.Description: Sun pale silk spun for Firstlight gear, soft on the spool and stubborn under a blade's wear.
Firstlight Weaver's Silk.Name: Firstlight Weaver's Silk

Blind Judge's Robes.Description: Pale robes crossed with cord, an orange scarf wound at the throat. Worn by a judge who could not see, and chose whatever path spilled the least blood.
Blind Judge's Robes.Name: Blind Judge's Robes

Bear Meat.Description: Fresh bear meat from Tom's hunts, bundled fast before the Bamboo Grove heat can sour it.
Bear Meat.Name: Bear Meat

Seismic Axe and Mace.Name: Seismic Axe and Mace
Seismic Axe and Mace.Description: Axe and chained weight both wrapped in open flame, cracking the ground under Stone Breathing footwork.

Fancy Katana.Name: Fancy Katana
Fancy Katana.Description: A road katana dressed rather better than the fights it usually sees, and not one bit sharper for it.

Murasaki Erimaki.Description: White winter cloth bordered in purple butterflies, a bright note against Iceveil's colorless roads.
Murasaki Erimaki.Name: Murasaki Erimaki

Hoshiko Kesa.Description: Star specked cloth draped for night travel, with tiny pale knots like map marks sewn into the weave.
Hoshiko Kesa.Name: Hoshiko Kesa

Shotgun.Name: Shotgun
Shotgun.Description: Built from water stained plans copied off a lost Slayer's weapon, it fights close with buckshot bursts and punishing holds.

Yagasuri Koshimaki.Description: Arrow fletch patterning wraps the waist, an old good-luck mark for leaving home and returning.
Yagasuri Koshimaki.Name: Yagasuri Koshimaki

Nightfall Gauntlet.Name: Nightfall Gauntlet
Nightfall Gauntlet.Description: Gold cased set gauntlets over wrapped knuckles, favoring sudden fistwork and throws that end a quarrel early.

Firstlight Insect Katana.Name: Firstlight Insect Katana
Firstlight Insect Katana.Description: A needle thin Firstlight blade under an ornate gold guard, built for the Insect school and never quite finished at the forge.

Mouth Dagger.Description: A short blade clenched in the teeth, on the reasoning that two hands and two swords were never going to be enough.
Mouth Dagger.Name: Mouth Dagger

Yang Fur Kesa.Name: Yang Fur Kesa
Yang Fur Kesa.Description: Pale smoke curls across black cloth, with a dark fur ruff at one shoulder and a white sash belted over it. Iceveil pikemen wear it on the high roads.

Battle Kimono Uniform.Name: Battle Kimono Uniform
Battle Kimono Uniform.Description: A navy sleeveless tunic buttoned high over a purple wrap and white sash, plain enough to fight in and neat enough to report in.

Lost Lantern.Name: Lost Lantern
Lost Lantern.Description: Taken from the Lost set, this lantern burns with a nervous glow, made for hands that never stopped moving.

Kintsugi Haori.Name: Kintsugi  Haori
Kintsugi Haori.Description: Gold repair lines run over battle dark cloth, every crack honored instead of hidden.

Nightfall Forged Ingot.Description: Blackened metal for Nightfall gear, forged to drink lamplight instead of throwing it back.
Nightfall Forged Ingot.Name: Nightfall Forged Ingot

Akazo's Top.Name: Akazo's Top
Akazo's Top.Description: Akazo's red sleeveless vest, marked in blue and cut for a Shockwave demon who settles things with fists well before blades.

Gauntlet.Name: Gauntlet
Gauntlet.Description: Dark plated fist guards set with a single red stone, turning bare hand work into flash strikes, broken footing, and throws.

Rare Fishing Rod.Description: A better built rod earned with Golden Fish. It reaches the brighter catches that the permit rod mostly misses.
Rare Fishing Rod.Name: Rare Fishing Rod

Bandage.Description: Field wrap for bad cuts. The healing comes only after the binding is finished.
Bandage.Name: Bandage

Zebra Fish.Description: Striped harbor fish with firm flesh, set aside for market crates and tailors who prize a clean stripe.
Zebra Fish.Name: Zebra Fish

Demonic Lantern.Name: Demonic Lantern
Demonic Lantern.Description: A horned lamp hung from a gnarled black branch, throwing a hungry orange glow where a carried flame would gutter out.

Sound Necklace.Name: Sound Necklace
Sound Necklace.Description: A violet note hung at the throat, silent until movement makes it answer in broken rhythm.

Firstlight Forged Ingot.Description: Bright forged metal for Firstlight gear, its face burnished like steel cooled under dawn.
Firstlight Forged Ingot.Name: Firstlight Forged Ingot

Firstlight Tanto.Name: Firstlight Tanto
Firstlight Tanto.Description: A short Firstlight blade for quick wrists, smithed from set stock rather than pulled off anything already dead.

Nightfall Claws Schematic.Description: Plans for a set of claws, each finger drawn against a hand that was not quite human.
Nightfall Claws Schematic.Name: Nightfall Claws Schematic

Golden Folk Mask.Name: Golden Folk Mask
Golden Folk Mask.Description: The gilt folk face every Iceveil road crew wears. Seeing two of them on one ridge is the whole warning you get.

Worm.Description: Fresh dock bait for the shallow table. Resolved bites take from the stack, whether the hook comes back full or bare.
Worm.Name: Worm

Golden Tentacle x10.Description: A small order of Golden Tentacle bait, delivered as a bundle rather than as a single lure.
Golden Tentacle x10.Name: Golden Tentacle x10

Nightfall Sickles Schematic.Description: Plans for a pair of sickles, the curves traced from a wet imprint left on the page and never cleaned off.
Nightfall Sickles Schematic.Name: Nightfall Sickles Schematic

Silent Striker Uniform.Description: Plain black shop cloth from Mistfall, tailored for quiet entrances and no questions at the counter.
Silent Striker Uniform.Name: Silent Striker Uniform

Fishing Permit.Description: Dock stamped permit bearing Sofen's approval. Proper rods are sold only after it is earned.
Fishing Permit.Name: Fishing Permit

Firstlight Bottom Schematic.Description: Plans for the trousers under the pale top, cut to the same white and gold as the rest of the set.
Firstlight Bottom Schematic.Name: Firstlight Bottom Schematic
